title: Concept: Location header carries an encoded line break
description: A percent-encoded CR or LF in the Location header means the application copied client input into a response header without filtering line breaks. One decoding step by an intermediary turns that into a second header, which is response splitting.
applicability: Responses that emit a redirect Location derived from a client-controlled value.
risk: An intermediary that decodes the value before forwarding can be made to emit a second header, enabling cache poisoning or script injection under the site origin.
